turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
It is time for you to learn you cannot have your way in every
                     little particular. Other people have their interests.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
. . . I am a free agent. If you find I fail to satisfy your terms I
                     will return your money at the end of this expedition.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: God damn it!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: What's going on?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: This is a business conversation.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
Is that what you call it. It sounds to me like you are still
                   being hoorawed by a little girl.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Did you say hooraw!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: That was the word.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I will show you hooraw!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
There is no hoorawing in it. My agreement with the Marshal
                   antedates yours. It has the force of law.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
The force of law! This man is a notorious thumper! He rode
                   by the light of the moon with Quantrill and Bloody Bill
                   Anderson!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Those men was patriots, Texas trash!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: They murdered women and children in Lawrence, Kansas.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: I was at Shreveport first with Kirby-Smith--

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: What side was you on?

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
I was in the army of Northern Virginia, Cogburn, and I don't
                     have to hang my head when I say it!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: If you had served with Captain Quantrill--

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Captain Quantrill indeed!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: You had best let this go, LeBoeuf!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Captain of what!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
Good, then! There are not sufficient dollars in the state of
                     Texas to make it worth my while to listen to your opinions,
                     day and night. Our agreement is nullified--it's each man for
                     himself!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: That suits me!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: We don't need him, do we Marshal?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
We'll miss his Sharp's carbine. It's apt to get lively out
                     here.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Hey.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Call that sport, do ya?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Stay here sister. I will see Bagby.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Has Chaney been here?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: No.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
But Coke Hayes was, two days ago. Coke runs with Lucky
                     Ned. He bought supplies, with this.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: This is Papa's gold piece! Tom Chaney, here we come!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: It is not the world's only California gold piece.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: They are rare, here.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
That would be a bitter disappointment, Marshal. What do
                     we do?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
We pursue. Ned is unfinished business for the marshals
                     anyhow, and when we have him we will also have Chaney
                     --or we can learn the whereabouts of his body. Bagby
                     doesn't know which way they went, but now we know they
                     come through here, they couldn't be going but one of two
                     ways: north toward the Winding Stair Mountains, or pushing
                     on further west. I suspect north. There is more to rob.

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote: Mr. Ferrington will want to know who cut loose his mule.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
Tell him it was Mr. James, a bank examiner from Clay
                     County, Missouri.

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote: The James boys is said to be slight, Frank and Jesse both.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
One of them has grown fat. The mule will not range far.
                     You boys mend your ways or I will return some dark night
                     and cut off one of your heads--I do not say which--and
                     leave it on the stomach of the other as a warning.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Hey!

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Who is out there?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: We are looking for shelter.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: No room for you here! Ride on!

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Ride on!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Who all is in there?

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote: A Methodist and a son-of-a-bitch!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Is that Emmett Quincy?

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote: I don't know any Emmett Quincy.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: There's only two of you!

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Me and Moon, but he is hit! He can't walk!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Drag him out! Light that lamp!

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: You said it was a man on the roof. I thought it was Potter.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: You was always dumb, Quincy, and remain true to form.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: My leg hurts.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Ned Pepper? I don't know him. Who is he?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: That don't bring anybody to mind.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: I don't know those boys. I always try to help out the law.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: You are trying to get at me.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: You are trying to get at me.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: We don't know those boys you are looking for.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: It ain't his leg.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: We are weary trappers.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: I am puzzled by this. (to Rooster) Why is she here?

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: My leg is giving me fits.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Easy now. He is trying to get at you.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I am getting at you with the truth.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: We seen Ned and Haze two days ago. We's supposed--

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Don't act the fool! If you blow I will kill you!

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: I am played out. I must have a doctor. We's supposed--

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: God damn it!

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: Oh lord, I am dying!

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: Don't leave me lying here! Don't let the wolves rip me up!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Should I tell him you was outlawed up?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Don't be looking for Quincy.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Is he dead?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: What was that?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Fingers.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: What do we do now?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: You will shoot him in the back?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: You display great poise.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: That is hard to believe.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: What is?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: One man riding at seven.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Why were they pursuing you?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: They was in the nature of a posse.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: It is all stealing.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: That is the position they took in New Mexico.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Hello?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: We have to warn him, Marshal!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Too late.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Oh!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: What do we do, Marshal?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: We sit. What does he do?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: He is a fine one for not drawing attention to himself.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Him in the woolly chaps is Lucky Ned.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Well, that's that.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Well that didn't pan out.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: You managed to put a kink in my rope, pardner.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: I am theverely injured.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Yes you got drug some.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Altho shshot. By a rifle.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: I believe I beh mythelf.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Hngnickh.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: What's that now?

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Knit.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Neither of these men are Chaney, Marshal.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Sleep well, Little Blackie. . .

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Malla-men what?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I have no doubt that the gun is sound.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: That was "Johnny in the Low Ground." There are very few

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I am going with you.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Oh, that izh not poshible.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
Have I held you back? I have a Colt's dragoon revolver
                     which I know how to use, and I would be no more of a
                     burden to you than I was to the marshal.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
That izh not my worry. You have earned your shpurzh, that
                     izh clear enough--you have been a regular "old hand" on the
                     trail. But Cogburn izh right, even if I would not give him the
                     shatishfaction of consheding it. The trail izh cold, and I am
                     conshiderably diminished.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
How can you give up now, after the many months you've
                     dedicated to finding Chaney? You have shown great
                     determination. I misjudged you. I picked the wrong man.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
I would go on in your company if there were clear way to go.
                     But we would be shtriking out blindly. Chelmshford izh
                     gone--we have chaished him right off the map. There izh
                     nothing for it. I am bound for Texash, and it izh time for you
                     to go home too.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I will not go back. Not without Chaney, dead or alive.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: I misjudged you as well. I eckshtend my hand.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Mr. LeBoeuf! Please!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Adiosh!

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote:
Well now I know you. Your name is Mattie. You are little
                     Mattie the bookkeeper. Isn't this something.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Yes, and I know you, Tom Chaney.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: What are you doing here?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I came to fetch water.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: I mean what are you doing here in these mountains?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
I have not been formally deputized but I am acting as an
                     agent for Marshal Reuben Cogburn and Judge Parker's court.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: Well I will not go. How do you like that?

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: That is interesting news. How many is up there?

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: I think I will oblige the officers to come after me.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: If you refuse to go I will have to shoot you.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: Oh? Then you had better cock your piece.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I know how to do it.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: I did not think you would do it.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: What do you think now?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Mattie!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I am down here! Chaney is taken into custody!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: No, you are just a piece of trash, that is all.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: Everything is against me. Now I am shot by a child.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Stop!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Help me! Down here! Hurry up!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Take them horses you got and move!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Get on up that hill! Don't you stop.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Marshal Cogburn and fifty more officers.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Tell me another lie and I will stove your head in!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Just the marshal.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Cogburn! Do you hear me?

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: The girl is nothing to me! She is a runaway from Arkansas!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: That is very well! Do you advise me to kill her?

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote:
Do what you think is best, Ned! She is nothing to me but a
                     lost child!

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: . . . Think it over first.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
I have already thought it over! You get mounted double fast!
                     If I see you riding over that bald ridge to the northwest I will
                     spare the girl. You have five minutes!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I will need more than five minutes!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: I will not give you more time.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
There will be a party of marshals in here soon, Ned! Let me
                     have Chaney and the girl and I will mislead them for six
                     hours!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
Too thin, Rooster! Too thin! Your five minutes is running!
                     No more talk!

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: I am leaving but you must give me time!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Up that hill!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Quiet there!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: You will not shoot me.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: I will do what I have to do.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Can I have some of that bacon?

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Help yourself. Have some of the coffee.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I do not drink coffee. I am fourteen.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
We do not have buttermilk. And we do not have bread. We
                    are poorly supplied. What are you doing here?

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: I will wring your scrawny neck!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
Let that go! Farrell, see to his wound. What happened?
                    What are you doing here?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
I will tell you what and you will see that I am in the right.
                    Tom Chaney there shot my father to death in Fort Smith and
                    robbed him of two gold pieces and stole his mare. Her name
                    is Judy but I did not see her down at the river. I was
                    informed Rooster Cogburn had grit and I hired him out to
                    find the murderer. A few minutes ago I came upon Chaney
                    watering the horses. He would not be taken in charge and I
                    shot him. If I had killed him I would not be now in this fix.
                    My revolver misfired.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
They will do it. It will embarrass you every time. Most girls
                    like to play pretties, but you like guns do you?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
I do not care a thing in the world about guns. If I did I would
                    have one that worked.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote:
I was shot from ambush, Ned. The horses was blowing and
                    making noise. It was that officer that got me.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: How can you sit there and tell such a big story?

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote:
That pit is a hundred feet deep and I will throw you into it
                    and leave you to scream and rot! How do you like that?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
No you won't. This man will not let you have your way. He
                    is your boss and you must do as he tells you.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: Five minutes is well up!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: I will give him a little more time.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: How much more?

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Til I think he has had enough.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Hold fast a while there, Doctor!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Why doesn't the Doctor do that?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: It was Marshal Cogburn and myself.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Yourself, eh? You and Cogburn, quite the posse.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Your friend is gone. You are alone.

turns.speaker: p14
turns.quote: We must move, Ned.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
You are too nervous, Doctor. It will be hours before he is
                    back with help.

turns.speaker: p15
turns.quote: Moo! Moo!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Hello, Ned. How many men are with the girl?

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: I call that bold talk for a one-eyed fat man!

turns.speaker: p15
turns.quote: Koo koo roo! Blawk!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Fill your hand, you son of a bitch!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Shoot them, Mr. LeBoeuf!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Mr. LeBoeuf!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Too far, moving too fasht.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Oh lord.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Some bully shot! Four hundred yards, at least!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: I am afraid I have--

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Stand up, Tom Chaney!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Mr. LeBoeuf! Are you alive!

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: Are you there?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I am here!

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: Can you clamber out?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I cannot!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Awake?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Yes!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Ahh!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: What is that?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I am bit!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Does Mr. LeBoeuf survive?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: My foot is pinned and leg broken.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I have her! Up with us!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I will send help for you as soon as I can. Don't wander off.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: We are not leaving him!

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: . . . I am in your debt for that shot, pard.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Never doubt the Texash Ranger.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: . . . Ever shtalwart!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Come on, you!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: We must stop. Little Blackie is played out.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: We have miles yet.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: No!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: He is getting away.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Who is getting away?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Chaney.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Hold on, sis.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Put your arms around my neck, I will carry.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Where are we?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I have grown old.

turns.speaker: p16
turns.quote: A quarter of a century is a long time.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Boy.
